about: Holidays in Lights runs November 27 through December 31, 2026 across Downtown Clearwater and Clearwater Beach, and the Santa Beach Dash is one of three featured events alongside the Run Run Rudolph 5K on December 5 and Light It Up Clearwater on New Year's Eve.
Pier 60 is at 370 Mandalay Ave on Clearwater Beach. The race itself is a half mile, so it is short enough for a family to walk together in Santa hats before the post race party.
faq: How long is the Santa Beach Dash?
The City of Clearwater describes it as a half mile festive run that starts at noon.
How much does the Santa Beach Dash cost?
The city lists registration at $25, with sign up through Eventbrite.
Where is the Santa Beach Dash held?
At Pier 60, 370 Mandalay Ave, Clearwater, on Sunday, December 20, 2026.
